text_block_list.text:
Since Transcend hasn't shown up for 
training, I was taking care of some other 
work when...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, sorry Trai-chan! I'm super late... 
or rather, basically skipping at this 
point!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"There was a special on TV about overseas 
gadgets. It was all new products, so I 
couldn't help getting glued to the 
screen..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Totes! I've reflected on it! I even bought 
a punctuality gadget, so I'm golden!

I cautioned Transcend to be more careful 
in the future.
